title: Instrument per-token timings and cache-hit attribution for cost/latency analysis
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Summary: Add fine-grained instrumentation to attribute latency and cost at the token level across the serving runtime. This ticket covers adding tracing hooks and metrics to capture per-token generation times, per-request KV-cache hit/miss impact, and propagation of token attribution through batching and fallback paths.

Goals: Capture per-token timing (ms) for key stages: tokenizer, model forward (per layer where feasible), KV cache lookup, kernel execution, and network serialization. Surface aggregated and sample-level views that map token cost to customer requests and model versions. Measure cache delta: estimate tokens saved via prefix/KV cache and translate to cost reduction.

Scope: Runtime instrumentation (C++/Rust kernels + runtime loop), tracing integration (OpenTelemetry spans + baggage), metrics pipeline (Prometheus counters/histograms -> OTLP -> Cortex), and dashboarding (Grafana panels + example alerts). Do not include front-end console UX changes beyond dashboard linking.

Design notes & trade-offs:
- Per-token spans add overhead; we will sample at 1% by default and enable full capture for a small set of customers during debugging.
- Histogram buckets will be tuned to avoid cardinality explosion; use exponential buckets for token latencies and tag with coarse dimensions (model, deployment, batch_size, cache_hit: yes/no).
- For batched requests, attribute kernel execution time proportionally by token count and include an uncertainty tag when exact attribution is ambiguous.
- KV cache impact is estimated by recording prefix length matched and cached_token_count; this is later transformed into cost-savings in the metrics transform layer.

Acceptance criteria:
- Runtime emits spans for token-generation lifecycle with standardized names and baggage fields.
- Prometheus-compatible metrics exposed: token_latency_histogram, token_count_total (by cache_hit label), cache_prefix_match_count, estimated_cached_tokens_saved.
- Sampling works end-to-end (1% default). Full-capture toggle works per-deployment via config flag.
- Grafana dashboard panels show: per-token p50/p95/p99 latencies, cache-hit vs miss latency deltas, estimated monthly cost-savings from cache by deployment.
- Unit/integration tests and a load test demonstrating <1.5% median overhead for sampled path and <0.05% for default path.

Notes: Links to protobufs and metrics schema are in the linked design doc. If this uncovers persistent kernel-level variance, follow-up tasks will include kernel-level tracing and sampling refinement.

2026-02-22 - Mei Chen (SRE): Reviewed metrics plan. Concern: high-cardinality tags (token_text_hash) must be hashed and not used as label in Prometheus. Recommend keep as span attribute only. Updated acceptance criteria to prevent high-cardinality labels.

2026-03-02 - Diego Martinez: Added metrics exporter changes to map token-level histograms into aggregated per-deployment histograms. Draft Grafana panels available: https://grafana.redwood/d/obs-token-attribution/overview

2026-03-08 - Product Review (Liam O'Connor): Requested a small sample dashboard for dedicated customers showing estimated $/month savings from cache. Added 'customer_impact' to metadata and a follow-up PM ticket for UI copy.
